observedIssue: Background capability probes may cross a reset boundary. Initial proxy request/usage counts are not strictly attributable to the evaluated session; reset injection counts can also exceed observed main-session retries.
evidencePolicy: Preserve raw proxy counts. Verify coverage using each session failed model requests, retry reasons and independent acceptance. Do not infer per-task cost from global proxy usage.
fixedBehavior: In-flight requests retain their starting window and fault configuration. Late usage still contributes to lifetime budget protection but not to the next trial.
proxyLogRedaction: Only the ready upstream address is replaced by <local-model-endpoint>.
